name: Cutting and burning logs (Ironman tiers)
where: Tree locations per tier (Lumbridge Castle top for normal logs, then oak, teak, mahogany, yew, ironwood)
note: Ironman guide: burn logs as cut in tier order; normal logs (Lumbridge Castle top, hop worlds to 15), oak (WC 15, to FM 39), teak (WC 35, FM 39–50), mahogany (FM 50–60), yew (FM 60–66/75/80), ironwood (WC 80, Sailing 72, FM 80–90/92); magic or redwood from WC 75 are fastest if no other use; no xp/h stated.
